name: Five-letter word deduction
summary: Guess a hidden five-letter word in six tries, with each guess colored by which letters are right, misplaced or absent.
core_loop: type a valid word → colored feedback per letter → use clues to narrow → repeat until solved or six guesses are spent
rules: guess must be a real word
green = right place, yellow = in word elsewhere, gray = absent
repeated letters are counted per occurrence
lose: use all six guesses without solving
scoring: fewer guesses is better, shown as an emoji grid
social_hooks: share the colored grid without spoilers
compare guess counts in a Group
example_prompts: a wordle for my friend group's inside jokes
wordle but only harry potter spells
wordle with 4 letters for a quick break
daily word game like wordle but about space

name: Multi-board word deduction
summary: Solve several word-deduction boards at once, where every guess is applied to all boards and the boards have shared guess budget.
core_loop: type one word → it scores on every board → pick next guess to help the unsolved boards → solve all before running out
rules: one guess applies to all unsolved boards
total guesses are limited to a few more than the board count
lose: run out of guesses with a board unsolved
social_hooks: race a friend on the same four words
share which board was the hardest
example_prompts: quordle but with pokemon names
two board wordle I can do on the bus
a dordle for my roommates

name: Custom word pool deduction
summary: A letter-deduction game where the secret words come from a pool the creator or Group wrote, such as names, places and in-jokes.
core_loop: see word length → guess → colored feedback → solve a word from your own world
pieces: secret word from a custom pool
rules: guess must be in the pool or the common word list
social_hooks: friends guess the one made for them
content_needs: words and names supplied by the maker
example_prompts: a wordle for my friend group's inside jokes
wordle with the names of everyone in our family
wordle of my college dorm's slang

name: Four-group connections
summary: Sixteen tiles hide four themed groups of four, and the player finds each group by selecting four tiles that share a link.
core_loop: scan tiles → select four you think belong together → submit → group locks in or a mistake is counted → solve all four
rules: a correct group locks and shows its theme
social_hooks: share the grid of difficulty colors
compare who found the purple group
make a puzzle for your friends
content_needs: four groups of four with red herrings
example_prompts: connections but all marvel characters
make me a connections puzzle for our friend group
connections with red herrings about 90s cartoons

name: Hex-letter word hive
summary: Seven letters around a center letter form as many words as possible, each containing the center letter, with a pangram worth a bonus.
core_loop: see seven letters → build words of four or more letters using the center → submit → climb rank tiers
rules: words need four or more letters
win: reach top rank or find all words
scoring: points per word with pangram bonus, rank by percent of max
social_hooks: Group shares one hive and pools found words
example_prompts: a spelling bee with only soccer words
spelling bee but the center letter changes every round
honeycomb word game for my team chat

name: Theme-word letter trail
summary: A grid of letters hides theme words that tile the whole board, and the player drags paths of adjacent letters to find them against a clue.
core_loop: read the theme clue → drag across adjacent letters → locked if it is a theme word → leftover words from the dictionary earn hints → fill the board
rules: paths use adjacent letters including diagonals
every letter belongs to exactly one theme word
a spanning word covers the theme
social_hooks: Group solves a themed grid together
example_prompts: a strands about harry potter houses
word search where the words share a secret theme
theme word trail about summer

name: Mini crossword
summary: A tiny five-by-five crossword filled by typing answers to across and down clues, played against the clock.
core_loop: read clue → type letters in the cell → advance to the next clue → finish the grid fast
rules: timer runs until the grid is correct
scoring: faster time is better, hints add a penalty
social_hooks: write a clue set for a friend
example_prompts: a mini crossword with all nba clues
daily crossword I can finish in a minute
make a crossword about our group chat

name: Category pinpoint
aliases: what do these have in common
summary: Up to five clues are revealed one at a time, all linked by one hidden category, and the player guesses the category as early as possible.
core_loop: see first clue → guess or reveal the next clue → guess the category → score by how few clues were needed
social_hooks: friends write clue sets for each other
example_prompts: pinpoint but with disney movies
what do these have in common game
a pinpoint about our friend group

name: Colored region queens
summary: Place one piece in every row, column and colored region of a grid so none touch, including diagonally.
core_loop: tap cells to cycle empty, mark, piece → apply constraints → eliminate → place all pieces
rules: one piece per row, column and region
pieces may not touch even diagonally
example_prompts: queens but with cats instead of crowns
a daily logic grid like linkedin queens
queens puzzle 7x7

name: Binary symbol grid
summary: Fill a grid with two symbols so no more than two match in a row, each row and column is balanced, and linked cells follow their sign.
core_loop: tap a cell to cycle symbol → use given clues and equal/opposite marks → deduce forced cells → complete grid
rules: each row and column has equal counts
sign marks force same or different
example_prompts: tango but with pizza and ice cream
a sun and moon logic puzzle
binary puzzle for my study group

name: Word ladder climb
summary: Climb a ladder of words by changing one letter each step, guided by clues, then reorder the rungs to reveal the top and bottom link.
core_loop: read clue → type the matching word → words lock at their rungs → reorder middle words so each differs by one letter → solve end words
rules: each adjacent word differs by one letter
social_hooks: make a ladder between two friend names
example_prompts: crossclimb but with sports words
word ladder from cat to dog
a ladder game about our school

name: Numbered path connect
summary: Draw a single path through every cell of a grid, touching the numbered cells in order.
core_loop: drag from 1 → route through cells → hit each number in order → fill every cell without crossing
win: cover the grid ending at the last number
example_prompts: zip but every number is a donut
a one-line path puzzle for my commute
numbered dots puzzle with walls

name: Rare-answer category quiz
summary: A category prompt; type one correct answer, and the rarer the answer among known correct ones, the more points it scores.
core_loop: read prompt → type an answer → see its rarity tier and points → next prompt → total score
rules: answer must fuzzy-match an accepted one
social_hooks: leaderboard of who found the rarest
content_needs: accepted answers with tiers and aliases
example_prompts: a harry potter krillion
make krillion
krillion about our friend group's trips
trivia where obscure answers win

name: Frame-by-frame reveal guess
summary: A famous work is shown through a sequence of stills that each reveal more, and the player guesses the title from the earliest one possible.
core_loop: view first still → guess or skip to next still → title accepted or after six guesses fail → score by stills used
rules: each wrong guess or skip reveals another frame
social_hooks: friends curate stills for each other
content_needs: image sets in progressive reveal order
example_prompts: framed but only studio ghibli
a daily guess the movie from stills
guess the show from six screenshots

name: Silhouette and distance guess
summary: A hidden place appears as a silhouette, and each guess reveals its distance and compass direction from the target.
core_loop: see outline → guess a place → get distance and direction → narrow → solve within six tries
content_needs: place list with outlines and coordinates
example_prompts: worldle but states only
a daily guess the country game
worldle for fictional places from my fantasy novel

name: Price guess higher or lower
summary: Guess the price of an item from its picture, and each guess is told higher or lower until the exact value is reached.
core_loop: see item → enter a price → told higher or lower → narrow → hit it within the tries
example_prompts: costcodle but for ikea stuff
guess the price of the item game
price guessing for my family's grocery run

name: Number target arithmetic
summary: Combine a handful of given numbers with arithmetic operations to reach a target number.
core_loop: see numbers and target → tap numbers and operators → build expression → reach or get as close as possible
rules: each number used at most once
operators are plus, minus, times, divide
example_prompts: a 24 game for my math class
countdown numbers round
make 100 with these six numbers

name: Longest word from letters
summary: Given a random set of nine letters, build the longest valid word using each letter at most once.
core_loop: see letters → rearrange → type or tile the word → submit → compare with the best word
example_prompts: longest word game from nine letters
word build game with spaceship letters only
countdown but with 30 seconds

name: Boggle word grid
summary: Find as many words as possible by dragging through adjacent letters on a 4x4 grid before time ends.
core_loop: swipe path through adjacent letters → release to submit → word scores by length → keep going until timer ends
rules: a cell is used once per word
social_hooks: same grid for the Group, rank scores
example_prompts: boggle with only food words
word hunt with a timer for road trips
4x4 letter swipe game

name: Nonogram pictures
summary: Number clues beside each row and column tell how many consecutive cells to fill, revealing a picture when solved.
core_loop: read row and column clues → fill or mark cells → deduce → complete the picture
rules: clue runs are in order with gaps between them
example_prompts: nonogram that reveals a cat
picross for a coffee break
make a nonogram of our team logo

name: Mine-field clear
summary: Reveal safe cells on a grid where numbers tell how many neighbors hold mines, flagging every mine.
core_loop: tap cell → number shows adjacent mines → deduce → flag mines → reveal all safe cells
example_prompts: minesweeper where mines are cats
a quick minesweeper with 3 lives
daily minesweeper for my friends

name: Attribute compare guess
summary: Guess a hidden person or character, and each guess reveals which of its attributes match, are higher or lower, or differ.
core_loop: type a guess from the list → see attribute tiles colored → narrow → repeat → find the secret
rules: numbers show up or down arrows
guess must be in the roster
social_hooks: friends try to find your secret
example_prompts: poeltl but for premier league players
a pokedle for digimon
character guesser for our friend group where attributes are things like height and favorite food

name: Semantic hot or cold
summary: Guess a secret word, and each guess reports how close its meaning is to the secret, ranking guesses by closeness.
core_loop: type a word → see its closeness rank → move toward meaning → find the word
rules: feedback is a rank or similarity score
content_needs: words with closeness ranking from embeddings
example_prompts: contexto but about music
semantle for my friend group
guess the secret word by meaning

name: Higher or lower stat chain
summary: Two items are shown, and the player picks which has more of a stat, with the winner staying for the next comparison until a miss.
core_loop: see two items → pick higher → reveal real number → continue streak

which has more game about video games
higher or lower for my town's facts

name: Emoji decode
summary: A row of emoji spells out a title, phrase or place, and the player types or selects the answer.

social_hooks: friends build emoji puzzles for each other
example_prompts: guess the disney movie from emojis
emoji puzzles about our trip
rebus puzzle game about meme titles

name: Timeline ordering

social_hooks: compare how far each friend got
example_prompts: timeline game for star wars
put events in order game
timeline of our friend group's year

name: Scramble and unscramble
summary: Scrambled letters of a word must be rearranged to form the answer, often with a category hint.
core_loop: see scramble → rearrange tiles → submit → next
example_prompts: unscramble names of our friend group

anagram dash 60 seconds

name: Cryptogram cipher

rules: each cipher letter maps to one plain letter
social_hooks: decode a message from a friend
example_prompts: cryptogram with song lyrics
send a secret message my friend has to decode

name: Song snippet guess

name: Zoomed or blurred image guess
aliases: Guess the game by its art
summary: A tightly cropped or pixelated image slowly widens or sharpens, and the player names the subject as early as possible.

example_prompts: zoomed in guess the pokemon
pixelated game where you guess the cartoon
guess the object from a closeup

name: Code breaker
summary: Crack a hidden code of colors or digits using feedback that tells how many are correct and how many are in the right spot.
core_loop: enter a guess → pegs show exact and partial matches → refine → crack the code
rules: feedback counts exact and misplaced only
social_hooks: set a code for a friend

name: Equation deduction
summary: Guess a hidden equation made of digits and operators, with colored feedback per symbol like a word game.
core_loop: type an equation → colors show right, misplaced or absent symbols → refine
rules: equation must be valid and equal
same coloring as a word game
example_prompts: nerdle with fractions

name: Letter-box word chain
summary: Letters sit on the four sides of a square, and the player chains words so each next letter is on a different side and each word starts with the last letter of the previous word, using all letters.
core_loop: tap letters to spell → chain words → cover all letters in few words
rules: consecutive letters come from different sides
next word starts with last letter
win: use all letters in a target number of words
example_prompts: letter boxed with only candy words

name: Tile pair clear
summary: Clear a layered pile of tiles by matching free pairs, with free tiles being those not covered or blocked on both sides.

rules: pairs must be identical or in a set

name: Rank by attribute

name: Survey top answers

win: fill the board or best score
social_hooks: poll your own Group to build the board

what did 100 people say

name: Sliding image puzzle

name: Light toggle grid

name: Pair flow paths
